title: sdks: unify auth/retries/streaming ergonomics and parity; bump versions
author: Avery Chen
release_notes:
- SDKs (Python/TS/Go): align auth configuration shape and default retry/backoff behavior.
- Streaming: consistent client-side streaming APIs and nicer ergonomics across languages.
- Parity & version bumps for Python v1.173.1, TS v1.173.1, Go v1.173.1.
description:
Motivation: We have a number of small but user-visible differences between SDK languages in how auth config, retry/backoff policies, and streaming APIs are expressed. This causes confusion for customers migrating between SDKs or composing multi-service clients. This PR unifies ergonomics and parity across Python, TypeScript, and Go: 1) standardize auth config and automatic token refresh hooks, 2) consolidate retry and backoff defaults (idempotency-aware), 3) provide a consistent streaming client API shape (sync/async parity where applicable), and 4) bump SDK package versions to signal the ergonomics changes.

Scope: The changes are intentionally API-compatible in most cases; a small number of callsites required parameter renames to improve discoverability. Where behavior changed (retry windows, default timeouts) we kept conservative defaults and documented the differences.

Checklist: 
- [x] Python SDK: unified auth object, retry/backoff middleware, streaming iterator ergonomic wrappers.
- [x] TypeScript SDK: matching auth/key rotation hooks, streaming transformer utilities, updated types.
- [x] Go SDK: auth provider interface harmonized, retry policy defaults, streaming client builder.
- [x] Tests updated across SDKs, added cross-language integration smoke tests.
- [x] Release notes and upgrade guidance added.

Testing & verification: Local unit + integration matrix (py/ts/go) ran. Added a cross-language canary that spins up a small local echo server to validate streaming parity under intermittent network drops. CI initially failed lint in TS due to an exported type rename; fixed in a follow-up commit.

Upgrade notes: Developers using advanced retry customization should verify that any custom retry policies implementing internal backoff expectations still behave as intended; default behavior is not more aggressive than before but is more idempotency-aware. Streaming API upgrade guide is documented in SDK CHANGELOGs.

Related: Linear ENG-5421 (SDK parity for auth/retries), ENG-5430 (streaming ergonomics).
